title: FastAPI
summary: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance Python web framework for building APIs using standard Python type hints, backed by Pydantic and Starlette.

title: OpenAPI
summary: OpenAPI (formerly Swagger) is the open standard specification for describing RESTful APIs; FastAPI generates a compliant schema automatically from type-annotated route definitions.

title: Pydantic
summary: Pydantic is a Python data validation library that uses standard type hints to validate, parse, and serialize data at runtime.

title: Starlette
summary: Starlette is a lightweight ASGI web toolkit for Python that provides the web layer (routing, middleware, WebSockets, CORS) underlying FastAPI.

title: Uvicorn
summary: Uvicorn is a high-performance ASGI server for Python used to run FastAPI and Starlette applications, optionally with uvloop for maximum throughput.
